title: Michael Talbot dies of the leukemia he wrote about in his vampire novel

tellings.quote: I visited him at the hospital before his death. And the irony of Michael Talbot's death is is that he had written a novel about a vampire novel in which he claimed that vampireism was a rare form of leukemia and then he contracted a rare form of leukemia that killed him.

plain: The writer Michael Talbot, author of The Holographic Universe, is said to have died in 1992 of a rare form of leukemia, after writing a vampire novel in which vampirism was itself a rare form of leukemia. Jeffrey Mishlove, who holds a PhD and studies psychic phenomena, tells Michels this first-hand: he visited Talbot in the hospital before his death and calls the coincidence the irony of it.
